description: Defines the ShippingSummary class which models shipping fee details, including costs, shipping module, options, and boolean flags for free shipping and tax applicability.

classes.name: ShippingSummary
classes.description: A Java class representing shipping fee details, including costs, shipping module, options, and flags indicating free shipping and tax status.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns the shipping cost as BigDecimal.

methods.name: getHandling
methods.description: Returns the handling fee as BigDecimal.

methods.name: getShippingModule
methods.description: Returns the name of the shipping module.

methods.name: isFreeShipping
methods.description: Indicates whether free shipping is applied.

methods.name: isTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Indicates whether tax applies to shipping.
